name: uniswap-mcp
description: MCP server over the Uniswap stack: per-pool quotes with initializedTicksCrossed, depth-at-size ladders, factory pool discovery, and Messari DEX AMM subgraph queries. No API key.
comment: No build step: Node runs the .ts files directly via type stripping, on by default since 22.18. That is why there is no 'main' pointing at a dist/ and why the bin is a .ts file.
